_about: Kelpie's demo (mods/kelpie/demo.js). `herdr-app do kelpie.demo` makes the Acme profile and opens these spaces; edit this file and press Refresh to change what it shows; `herdr-app do kelpie.demo-github` shows the same issues as a GitHub Project (`project`), `kelpie.demo` puts Jira back; `herdr-app do kelpie.demo-remove` takes it all away. Times are relative: -25m, -3h, -2d. A pull request's `later` ({after: seconds, checks…}) takes its place that long after kelpie.demo ran, so a change can be watched reaching the list; one with `opens` ({after, found}) is opened by an agent `after` seconds in and found by GitHub's search only `found` seconds in. Its links can't reach anyone: Jira at jira.example.com (reserved for examples), GitHub as kelpie--demo (GitHub allows no double hyphen in a name).

issues.description:
Travellers open saved trips on planes, trains and in roaming dead zones. Today the trip screen shows a spinner and then an error when there's no network, even for trips that were opened a minute ago.

## What we want

Saved trips open instantly from the device, and changes made offline (notes, reordered stops, a new booking) are kept and synced once the connection is back.

- Cache every trip the traveller opened in the last 30 days in `IndexedDB`
- Queue edits made offline and replay them in order
- Show a calm banner while offline, never a blocking error

## Out of scope

Downloading map tiles: that's ACME-190.

## Done when

1. A trip opened once opens again in airplane mode, within 300 ms
2. An edit made offline shows on another device a minute after going back online
3. Conflicts keep the newest change and say so in the trip's history
Add a `TripCache` on top of the trips store: write a trip through on every successful load, read it first when the network fails. Keep at most 30 days of trips and drop the oldest first.

issues.description:
Let travellers pay with **Apple Pay** on the checkout page in Safari and the iOS app.

## Notes

- The merchant session is created by the payments service, never in the browser
- Receipts for wallet payments go out like card receipts
- Behind the `wallet-payments` flag until finance signs off

issues.description:
Searching for `barcleona` or `amstredam` finds nothing today. Match destinations and hotels within one or two typos, ranking exact matches first.

## Approach

A trigram index on names in the search service, with a similarity floor of 0.3, then the usual popularity ranking.

issues.summary: Show times in each stop's time zone
issues.description: Started on another machine, so nothing of it is open here. A trip's times show in the traveller's own time zone, which is wrong for every stop abroad: show each booking in its stop's local time, with the zone beside it.
Travellers want a printable itinerary: every booking of a trip on one page, with confirmation numbers and addresses, as a PDF from the trip's share menu.
Password reset emails are plain text and land in spam. Send them from the transactional template, with a link that expires after an hour.
Travellers set the same filters on every search. Keep the last filters they used and set them again on the next search, with a way to clear them.

Show every price in the currency of the traveller's account, converted at the day's rate, with the original price in a tooltip.

files.patch:
@@ -18,11 +18,15 @@ def search(term: str, limit: int = 20):
     """Destinations and hotels whose name matches the term, best first."""
-    rows = db.fetch(
-        "SELECT id, name, kind FROM places WHERE name ILIKE %s ORDER BY popularity DESC LIMIT %s",
-        (f"%{term}%", limit),
-    )
+    rows = db.fetch(
+        """SELECT id, name, kind, similarity(name, %s) AS score
+           FROM places WHERE name %% %s
+           ORDER BY name ILIKE %s DESC, score DESC, popularity DESC
+           LIMIT %s""",
+        (term, term, term, limit),
+    )
     return [Place(**row) for row in rows]
